Fits the hierarchical psychometric sem model in JAGS
```{r}
library(R2jags)
library(polspline)   # logspline density for Savage-Dickey Bayes factors

refit    <- FALSE                          # TRUE = rerun JAGS; FALSE = load saved fit
fit_file <- "Data/summary/sem.rds"
perc_tasks <- c("TLetter", "TGabor", "TPi", "SLetter", "SGabor", "SPi")
cog_tasks  <- c("OSpan", "CSpan", "Corsi", "Matrix")
vis_names  <- c("V", "Bwd", "Sim", "Letter", "Gabor", "Pi")   # visual factors
n_perc_task <- length(perc_tasks)
n_cog_task  <- length(cog_tasks)

# posterior mean [95% CI]
ci <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", mean(x), quantile(x, .025), quantile(x, .975))
```

```{r}
# Process perception data: log transform, then standardize within task
perc_df <- read.csv("Data/summary/all_perception_raw.csv")
perc_df$correct_num <- ifelse(perc_df$correct == "True", 1, 0)
perc_df$x_raw <- ifelse(perc_df$staircase == 2, perc_df$param1, perc_df$param2)
perc_df <- perc_df[perc_df$x_raw > 0, ]
perc_df$x <- log(perc_df$x_raw)
perc_df$x <- ave(perc_df$x, perc_df$task_name, FUN = function(v) as.numeric(scale(v)))

# Exclude (subject, task) cells that are >4SD outliers or have a non-converged staircase
clean_scores    <- read.csv("Data/summary/all_scores_clean.csv")
clean_scores$id <- as.character(clean_scores$id)
excluded_cells <- do.call(rbind, lapply(perc_tasks, function(t) {
  bad_ids <- clean_scores$id[is.na(clean_scores[[t]])]
  if (length(bad_ids) == 0) return(NULL)
  data.frame(id = bad_ids, task_name = t, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
perc_df$id <- as.character(perc_df$id)
perc_df <- subset(perc_df, !(paste(id, task_name, sep = "_") %in%
                             paste(excluded_cells$id, excluded_cells$task_name, sep = "_")))

# Map subject id and task name to indices
ids <- sort(unique(perc_df$id))
perc_df$id_idx   <- match(perc_df$id, ids)
perc_df$task_idx <- match(perc_df$task_name, perc_tasks)
n_subj <- length(ids)

# Aggregate Bernoulli trials -> Binomial counts
agg_df <- aggregate(correct_num ~ id_idx + task_idx + x, data = perc_df,
                    FUN = function(v) c(k = sum(v), n = length(v)))
agg_df <- data.frame(agg_df[, 1:3], k = agg_df$correct_num[, "k"], n = agg_df$correct_num[, "n"])

# Cognitive scores: standardized and sign-flipped (higher = worse, as thresholds)
cog <- read.csv("Data/summary/all_cognitive_scores.csv")
cog$id <- as.character(cog$id)
cog <- reshape(cog, idvar = "id", timevar = "task_name", direction = "wide")
names(cog) <- gsub("^score\\.", "", names(cog))
cog[, cog_tasks] <- -scale(cog[, cog_tasks])
cog <- as.matrix(cog[match(ids, cog$id), cog_tasks])
```



```{r}
# Guessing rate per task (set to 0 to drop the lower asymptote)
guess <- c(TLetter = 1/9, TGabor = 1/2, TPi = 1/2, SLetter = 1/9, SGabor = 1/2, SPi = 1/2)

# Specific factors each task loads on:  Bwd Sim Letter Gabor Pi
free <- rbind(TLetter = c(1, 0, 1, 0, 0),
              TGabor  = c(1, 0, 0, 1, 0),
              TPi     = c(1, 0, 0, 0, 1),
              SLetter = c(0, 1, 1, 0, 0),
              SGabor  = c(0, 1, 0, 1, 0),
              SPi     = c(0, 1, 0, 0, 1))
mask_col <- c(1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2)   # column of the masking factor in share_spec
stim_col <- c(3, 4, 5, 3, 4, 5)   # column of the stimulus factor in share_spec

jags_data <- list(
  N = nrow(agg_df), I = n_subj, J = n_perc_task, D = ncol(free), Cn = n_cog_task,
  id = agg_df$id_idx, task = agg_df$task_idx, s = agg_df$x,
  k = agg_df$k, ntrials = agg_df$n,
  guess = unname(guess[perc_tasks]), eps = 1e-6,
  free = unname(free), cog = unname(cog)
)

# Init using per-task probit MLE
mle_theta <- matrix(NA, n_subj, n_perc_task)
mle_beta  <- numeric(n_perc_task)
for (t in seq_along(perc_tasks)) {
  sub <- subset(perc_df, task_name == perc_tasks[t])
  sub$id <- factor(sub$id, levels = ids)
  cf <- coef(glm(correct_num ~ 0 + id + x, data = sub, family = binomial(link = "probit")))
  b  <- -cf["x"]
  a  <- cf[grepl("^id", names(cf))]
  mle_theta[match(sub("^id", "", names(a)), ids), t] <- a / b
  mle_beta[t] <- b
}
for (t in seq_along(perc_tasks)) mle_theta[is.na(mle_theta[, t]), t] <- mean(mle_theta[, t], na.rm = TRUE)
mle_theta <- apply(mle_theta, 2, function(v) pmin(pmax(v, quantile(v, .02)), quantile(v, .98)))  # trim extreme MLEs

inits <- function() list(
  mu = colMeans(mle_theta), beta = mle_beta,
  theta = mle_theta + matrix(rnorm(length(mle_theta), 0, .02), n_subj),
  lambda_gen = rep(.3, n_perc_task), lambda_spec = ifelse(free == 1, .3, 1e-4),
  pDelta2 = rep(4, n_perc_task), gamma = c(.3, rnorm(ncol(free), 0, .1)),
  lambda_c = rep(.5, n_cog_task), mu_c = rep(0, n_cog_task), pDelta2_c = rep(2, n_cog_task),
  eta_all = matrix(rnorm(n_subj * (ncol(free) + 2), 0, .1), n_subj)
)
inits_clean <- function() lapply(inits(), unname)

# Run model
pars <- c("mu", "beta", "lambda_gen", "lambda_spec", "delta2", "lambda_c",
          "gamma", "gamma_std", "share_gen", "share_spec", "share_uni")
if (refit || !file.exists(fit_file)) {
  fit <- jags(data = jags_data, inits = inits_clean, parameters.to.save = pars,
              model.file = "Model/sem.jags",
              n.chains = 3, n.iter = 30000, n.burnin = 10000, n.thin = 10)
  saveRDS(fit, fit_file)
} else {
  fit <- readRDS(fit_file)
}
sl <- fit$BUGSoutput$sims.list

# Diagnostics
summ <- fit$BUGSoutput$summary
key  <- grepl("^(mu|beta|lambda_gen|lambda_c|delta2|gamma|share_gen|share_uni)\\[", rownames(summ))
cat("Max Rhat:        ", max(summ[key, "Rhat"]), "\n")
cat("Min n_eff:       ", min(summ[key, "n.eff"]), "\n")
cat("Posterior draws: ", nrow(sl$gamma), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Table 1: proportion of variance of each masking task due to each source
shV <- sl$share_gen
shM <- sapply(1:n_perc_task, function(j) sl$share_spec[, j, mask_col[j]])
shS <- sapply(1:n_perc_task, function(j) sl$share_spec[, j, stim_col[j]])
shU <- sl$share_uni

tab_shares <- data.frame(
  Task     = c(perc_tasks, "Average"),
  V        = c(apply(shV, 2, ci), ci(rowMeans(shV))),
  Masking  = c(apply(shM, 2, ci), ci(rowMeans(shM))),
  Stimulus = c(apply(shS, 2, ci), ci(rowMeans(shS))),
  Unique   = c(apply(shU, 2, ci), ci(rowMeans(shU)))
)
print(tab_shares, row.names = FALSE)

# P(average stimulus share > average masking share)
mean(rowMeans(shS) > rowMeans(shM))
```

```{r}
# Table 2: correlation of each visual factor with C, and Savage-Dickey BF10 (prior b_k ~ N(0, 1))
g  <- sl$gamma;     colnames(g)  <- vis_names   # regression weights b_k
gs <- sl$gamma_std; colnames(gs) <- vis_names   # correlations with C

bf10 <- sapply(vis_names, function(f) dnorm(0, 0, 1) / dlogspline(0, logspline(g[, f])))

tab_cor <- data.frame(
  Factor = vis_names,
  r      = apply(gs, 2, ci),
  BF10   = round(bf10, 2)
)
print(tab_cor, row.names = FALSE)

# Variance of C explained by V
ci(gs[, "V"]^2)
```
